verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is a proprietary global edge platform; there is no vendor documentation for running the production runtime, KV/D1/R2 or global network yourself. The open-source 'workers-sdk' includes only a local simulator (workerd) for testing, not the actual hosted product, and community comments explicitly cite vendor lock-in (KV/D1) as a barrier to running the same code on self-hosted infrastructure.
